title: N-Puzzle Solver using A* Algorithm
description: An intelligent puzzle solver implementing the A* search algorithm with multiple heuristic functions for optimal pathfinding.
body:
# N-Puzzle Solver

Developed an efficient N-puzzle solver using the A* search algorithm with multiple heuristic functions including Manhattan distance and linear conflict.

## Features
- Multiple heuristic options
- Optimal solution guarantee
- Performance metrics tracking
- Visualization of solution path

## Technical Implementation
Implemented using Python with focus on algorithm efficiency and memory optimization.
